shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, the U.S. Department of Justice said Walmart agreed to pay $50 million to settle allegations related to illegally issuing opioid prescriptions, and the company also signed a memorandum of agreement with the Drug Enforcement Administration to clarify its future obligations…

children: According to Wallstreetcn, the U.S. Department of Justice said Walmart agreed to pay $50 million to settle allegations related to illegally issuing opioid prescriptions, and the company also signed a memorandum of agreement with the Drug Enforcement Administration to clarify its future obligations in dispensing controlled substances.

title: Walmart Agrees to Pay $50 Million to Resolve Opioid Prescription Allegations
